description: This file defines the IFrontPanel interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It declares methods for controlling front panel lights, LEDs, brightness, and blink patterns, and includes related data structures and type aliases.

classes.name: IFrontPanel
classes.description: Interface for controlling front panel features such as lights, LEDs, brightness, and blinking patterns.

classes.name: FrontPanelSuccess
classes.description: Structure indicating success status of front panel operations.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the front panel with the provided service.

methods.name: GetBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the brightness level for a given index.

methods.name: GetFrontPanelLights
methods.description: Retrieves supported front panel lights and their info.

methods.name: SetBlink
methods.description: Sets a blink pattern for an LED based on a JSON string.

methods.name: SetBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness for a specified LED.

methods.name: SetLED
methods.description: Sets the color and brightness of an LED.
